changelog:
First sideload release.

MobileIPTV is a player. You supply your own source; nothing is bundled.

**Sources**
- Add an Xtream line or an M3U playlist. Xtream URLs are auto-corrected, and a
  pasted URL that carries credentials fills the fields for you.
- Test Connection reports the account's real state before you commit to an import.
- Edit a source without losing anything: renaming or fixing a URL keeps every
  favourite, watch time and category choice.

**Catalog**
- Live, Movies and Series, each with its own search and its own empty state.
- Categories can be enabled or disabled in bulk, honouring whatever filter is on
  screen.
- Content languages are detected per item and can be filtered, with a one-tap
  "Only this language".
- Search matches from the start of a name and falls back to matching anywhere in
  it, so a name carrying a country prefix is still findable.
- Large catalogs are the design target: browsing stays responsive at hundreds of
  thousands of items.

**Guide**
- XMLTV guide ingest with automatic URL discovery.
- Now and next shown against each channel, recomputed when you return to the app.
- A per-channel schedule screen.

**Playback**
- Hardware decode by default, with automatic fallback and a per-stream blocklist
  for devices that mishandle a particular stream.
- Channel up/down surfs the list you were browsing.
- Aspect and zoom modes are remembered and applied to the first frame.
- The screen stays awake while playing or buffering.
- Stalls and errors are detected and recovered from, with bounded retries and a
  plain-language message when a stream genuinely cannot play.

**Other**
- Check visible channels for a working stream, paced so it will not trip a
  provider's rate limits.
- Favourites and watch history.
- In-app update checking for this sideload build.

Known limits: multi-view, picture-in-picture, DVR, catchup and recording are not
in this build.
